_source: Hand-worked by seat 1 in cpf-cap-template.xlsx (exported as cpf-cap-template.pdf), 2026-10-29, from the D37 rule and the inputs below. Not derived from evaluate() or from AI output; checked independently by Claude from the written rules (all 18 figures match).
_rule: D37 (#42): cap = factor x Valuation Limit, factor = 100% - 2% x (95 - (youngest buyer's age at purchase + remaining lease)), only when the lease falls short; valuation = price (stated assumption); grants count towards the cap (seat 1, stated assumption); what the cap stops moves to the next source in the D28 order; a fee is paid whole from CPF only if both the OA left and the cap left cover it; instalments from the OA while both last (D24).
_inputs: evaluate.json case E1 (resale, HDB loan) with buyers aged 40 and 41 today, each cpfOaBalanceCents 15000000, purchasePriceCents and marketValueAtKeysCents 40000000, remainingLeaseYears 50, assumptions.horizonYear 2045. Given (evaluate() before the cap): price at purchase 412,000.00; grants 125,000.00; max loan 284,280.00; stamp duty 6,960.00; legal 2,500.00; agent 5,000.00.
